   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      18 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 08.06.2026 - 21.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Bill_The_Window_Man_, 21.08.2026, 1/5: "This app is borderline unusable now it get worse every update, the UI becomes worse to use, core features harder to access, whole app is slower."
            2. _C0NN0RAD0_, 21.08.2026, 1/5: "I used to really love opal but the last few months it’s went really down hill and very buggy, I often find it not locking apps at the end of breaks, certain rules not staying paused or reset despite asking them to be reset or paused for xyz time, the app frequently freezing. I can no longer rely on it to reliably enforce screen time and habits."
            3. _S.ley1'_, 04.08.2026, 1/5: "The app glitches. Sometimes it blocks outside block moments and then doesn't unblock or the app completely malfunctions."
